name: SkillQuest AI
tagline: Turn any skill into a world of quests, practice, and visible progress.
description: SkillQuest AI turns a real learning goal into a personalized adventure. Anna creates a structured quest map, practical daily missions, milestone challenges, and a final boss project around the learner's available time and desired outcome. Learners can complete evidence-based missions, earn XP, grow a skill tree, maintain a streak, ask a context-aware Mentor for help, review feedback, keep a learning journal, and export their complete progress. Core progression remains usable with transparent local fallbacks when a hosted model is unavailable, and all personal learning data is stored through Anna Storage without a separate API key.
